steps.what: Show the operation steps already written for this system.
Train system users in system operation or maintenance.
Note the operation that was shown, not a grade of the user.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows operation steps already written. The systems engineer trains the users in operation or maintenance. The note records the operation that was shown. It does not grade the user. A course with no written steps is taught from the engineer's own demonstration.
tasks.previous_blocker: Attendance was stored as if it were a score of who had learned the system.
tasks.enabler_now: Written operation steps can be shown. The training still happens with the users.
tasks.still_hard: A user who cannot follow a step still has to be shown it by the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer trains the users. The note names the operation shown and does not grade anyone.
tasks.altitude: Training stays with the users and the engineer. The note is a record of what was shown, not a score.

reach.task: Help a user with a step the engineer has already shown.
reach.learn: A session note is not a grade.

evidence.claim: Showing written operation steps is a lookup. It does not train the user.
The session note names the operation that was shown. It is not a grade of the user and it does not rate staff.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A systems engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the design, and a draft is not the accepted system.
Fields: The course id and steps already written. The note has no score field. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the systems engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the operation steps before the session.
unknowns: Whether operation training and maintenance training share one step list.
research_questions: Who may see the session note besides the engineer and the user who was present?

already_counted.description: Training the users stays with the engineer.
Writing the session note stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop step lists for systems that have been retired.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still trains the users in operation or maintenance and still notes what was shown. Only showing steps already written is removed. The note does not grade the user. A course with no written steps saves none of the training.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show operating conditions and any result already stored for this model.
Complete the model or simulation and predict performance under those conditions.

tasks.design: The {DATA_PLATFORM} shows operating conditions and any result already stored. An existing solver's run is not the engineer's time and is not counted. The systems engineer completes the model or the simulation and predicts performance under those conditions. A missing condition is not filled with a typical value. The stored result is not the prediction.
tasks.previous_blocker: A stored result from different conditions was presented as the prediction for this case.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored conditions can be shown. Completing the model and predicting performance still take the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: Performance under conditions the record does not hold has to be judged by the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer completes the model and writes the prediction. A stored result from other conditions is not reused.
tasks.altitude: The model, the simulation, and the prediction stay with the engineer. Stored conditions are visible and are not the answer.

reach.task: Read a prediction the engineer has written for stated conditions.
reach.learn: A stored result is not this prediction.

evidence.claim: Showing stored conditions is a lookup. An existing solver's run is not saved human labour.
The engineer completes the model and predicts performance. A result stored for different conditions is not reused, and a missing condition is not invented.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A systems engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the design, and a draft is not the accepted system.

Fields: The model id and conditions already stored. A missing condition is not filled with a typical value. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the systems engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the stored conditions before running anything the engineer chooses to run.
unknowns: Whether manual models and automated tools share one condition record.
research_questions: Who checks a prediction when the conditions were measured by another team?

already_counted.description: Completing the model and predicting performance stay with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop stored results whose conditions have been replaced.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still completes the model or simulation and still predicts performance under the stated conditions. Only showing conditions and results already stored is removed. The solver's run is not counted. A missing condition saves nothing and is not invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the controller specification already agreed.
Develop efficient and effective system controllers.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the controller specification already agreed. The systems engineer develops the controller so that it is effective for that specification. The specification is not the controller. A blank specification stops the work, and the engineer does not copy a controller from another system.
tasks.previous_blocker: A controller from a similar system was reused because the specification was a single unchecked paragraph.
tasks.enabler_now: An agreed specification can be shown. Developing the controller still takes the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the controller is effective on this system, rather than on the one it was copied from, stays with the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer develops the controller. The specification is not the design.
tasks.altitude: Controller development stays with the engineer. The agreed specification is only the text already accepted.

reach.task: Review a controller the systems engineer has developed.
reach.learn: A specification is not the controller.

evidence.claim: Showing an agreed specification is a lookup. It does not develop the controller.
A blank specification does not inherit a controller from another system. The engineer develops it.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A systems engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the design, and a draft is not the accepted system.

Fields: The controller id and the specification only if it is already agreed. A blank specification is not filled from another controller. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the systems engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the specification in the document store before development.
unknowns: Whether efficiency and effectiveness are both written on the same specification.
research_questions: Who tests the controller on the live system after the engineer has developed it?

already_counted.description: Developing the controller stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop specifications for controllers that have been retired.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still develops the system controller. Only showing a specification that was already agreed is removed. A blank specification saves nothing, and a controller is not copied from another system.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the specification already accepted for this application.
Develop the application-specific software and accept the build.
File the accepted build reference for that application.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the specification already accepted. The systems engineer develops the application-specific software and accepts the build. A pipeline's existing run is not the engineer's time and is not counted. Only the accepted build reference is filed. An unaccepted change is not merged. A blank specification is not turned into code.
tasks.previous_blocker: A generated change was merged because the specification was long and nobody compared the build with it.
tasks.enabler_now: An accepted specification can be shown. Developing the software and accepting the build still take the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing that the build does not do what the specification says stays with the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer develops the software and accepts the build. A generated change is not merged on its own.
tasks.altitude: Software development and acceptance stay with the engineer. The file holds the accepted build reference and does not merge anything else.

reach.task: Continue from a build the engineer has accepted.
reach.learn: A generated change is not the accepted build.

evidence.claim: Showing an accepted specification is a lookup. It does not develop the software.
The engineer develops the software and accepts the build. A generated change is not merged, and an existing pipeline run is not this labour.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A systems engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the design, and a draft is not the accepted system.

Fields: The application id and the specification only if it is already accepted. A blank specification is not turned into code. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the systems engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the specification before development. Do not merge a change the engineer has not accepted.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the systems engineer.
unknowns: Whether this application shares its specification with another system.
research_questions: Who may merge after the engineer has accepted the build?

already_counted.description: Developing the software and accepting the build stay with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop build references whose specification has been replaced.

approvals.approved_version: build version and the specification id it cites

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still develops the application-specific software and still accepts the build. Only showing the accepted specification, and filing that build reference, is removed. A pipeline's run is not counted. An unaccepted change is not merged, and a blank specification saves nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The systems engineer still trains the users, still interprets the model, and still develops the software. A stored step or a stored specification can be opened. It does not teach, predict, or build.
reach: Software developers write application code, and this job learns the engineer still develops it and still accepts the build.
Computer network support specialists sit with users, and this job learns a shown step is not a grade of the user.
skills_to_grow: Train the user on the operation, and note what was shown without grading the person.
Interpret the model under the stated conditions, and do not treat a stored result as the prediction.
Develop the software from the specification, and file only the build just accepted.
role.ambitious_version: Training, model interpretation, controller design, and software development stay with the engineer. Stored steps and specifications only show what was already written.
